job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required for this step on its assigned station, in consistent time units (e.g., minutes). While running, the step exclusively occupies the station for this duration.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of garments (pieces of clothing) that must be altered this morning. The scheduler uses this count to know how many job sequences must be placed on the workshop stations.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct workshop stations or machines (e.g., sewing machine, pressing station, button fitter) available. This tells the scheduler how many resource types can be occupied concurrently.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each garment/job (one per piece to be altered). Each identifier connects that garment to its ordered list of alteration steps.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each station/machine in the shop. Tasks reference these IDs to indicate which physical station they must run on.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the garment this task belongs to (matches one of the entries in garment_ids). Used to sequence tasks for the same piece so they occur in the required order.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the task within the garment's fixed sequence of alteration steps (first step = 0 or 1 depending on convention). The scheduler must preserve increasing step_index order for each garment.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific station/machine required for this alteration step (matches one of the station_ids). This defines which resource the task will occupy and prevents overlapping use of the same equipment.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required for the task on its designated station, expressed in consistent time units (e.g., minutes). The scheduler uses these durations to place tasks on machines and compute the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of landscaping projects to schedule. Each project is a job that consists of a fixed ordered sequence of site activities that must be performed in the given order.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct machines/equipment units available (e.g., mower, loader, excavator). Each machine can handle at most one activity at a time and is referenced by tasks below.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the landscaping projects (jobs). These identifiers link tasks to the correct project and its ordered activity sequence.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the machines/equipment referenced by tasks. Use these IDs to assign activities to specific machines when building the schedule.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the landscaping project that this activity belongs to; used to enforce the ordering of activities within the same project.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position index of this activity within its project’s fixed sequence (e.g., 0, 1, 2...), indicating the required order relative to other activities of the same project.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific machine/equipment that must perform this activity. The activity can only be scheduled on this machine and cannot overlap with other activities assigned to it.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required for the activity on its required machine. This is the contiguous time length the machine must be scheduled for this activity (units are consistent across all activities).

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of circuit boards (jobs) in the current batch to be assembled. This tells the scheduler how many separate boards must complete their full sequence of assembly steps.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct assembly stations (machines) available — e.g., pick-and-place, solder, test stations. Each station can process at most one operation at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each circuit board job in the batch. Each identifier links a board to its ordered sequence of operations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the available assembly stations. These IDs are referenced by tasks to indicate where a given operation must run.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific circuit board this operation belongs to (matches an entry from board_ids). Used to enforce the per-board order of steps.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the operation within the board's fixed sequence (1 = first operation, 2 = second, etc.). Operations must be scheduled in increasing operation_index for each board.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required assembly station where this operation must run (matches an entry from station_ids). Only that station can execute the operation.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The time required to perform this operation on its station (time unit consistent across all tasks). This determines how long the station is occupied when the operation runs.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of furniture pieces (jobs) to process — e.g., count of tabletops and chairs that must each go through the shop’s operations. Use this to know how many separate item schedules are required.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct tools or stations available in the shop (for example: saw, sander, finishing bench). Each station can handle at most one operation at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each furniture piece (job). Each identifier represents a specific piece that must follow its ordered sequence of steps.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the available tools/stations. Each identifier corresponds to a specific machine (saw, sander, finishing bench) that tasks may require.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the furniture piece this task belongs to. All tasks sharing the same piece_id are steps on the same item and must respect their given order.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this operation within the piece’s fixed sequence (e.g., 1 = cut, 2 = sand, 3 = finish). This enforces the precedence order for that piece.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required tool/station for this step (specifies which station — saw, sander, finishing bench — must be used). The step must be scheduled on this tool.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: How long the step occupies its required tool (in the instance’s time units). The tool must be reserved for the entire processing_time without overlap with other tasks.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of parcels (jobs) that must be processed through the sorting hub; defines how many separate to-do lists of sequential steps need scheduling.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct pieces of equipment (machines) available in the hub (e.g., scanners, sorters, conveyors) that can perform steps; each equipment can handle at most one step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each parcel (job). Each identifier links to a fixed ordered list of steps that parcel must undergo in sequence.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each piece of equipment (machine) in the hub. Each id is referenced by steps to indicate where that step must run.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the parcel this step belongs to; used to enforce the required order of steps for that parcel.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index (position) of this step in the parcel's ordered sequence of operations; lower indices must be scheduled before higher ones for the same parcel.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required equipment on which this step must run (e.g., a particular scanner or handler); no two steps may occupy the same equipment at overlapping times.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Expected processing time for this step on its required equipment (time units); this is the uninterrupted time the equipment must be reserved to complete the step.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of booths to prepare. This is the count of job sequences (one job per booth) that must be scheduled so all booths are finished.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct resources (named lifts or tools) available. Each resource can serve at most one task at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each booth (each identifier denotes a job whose tasks must be performed in the given order).

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the available lifts and tools (each identifier names a resource that tasks may require).

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the booth this assembly step belongs to; tasks sharing the same booth_id form that booth's ordered sequence and must respect their order.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Sequence index of this assembly step within its booth's task list. A lower step_index indicates an earlier step that must complete before later steps start.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific lift or tool required for this step. This named resource must be exclusively available for the step's duration (no overlap with other steps using the same id).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required to perform this assembly step using the specified lift/tool. All durations use the same time units (e.g., minutes) and determine how long the resource is occupied.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of recipes (meals) that must be prepared; each recipe is a job consisting of ordered steps.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct kitchen appliances available (e.g., oven, stove, blender), each can run at most one step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each recipe (job); used to group that recipe's ordered steps.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each appliance (machine) available in the kitchen; steps reference these to indicate which appliance they require.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the recipe to which this step belongs; links the step to its recipe's ordered sequence.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this step within its recipe's required order (1st step, 2nd step, etc.); steps for a recipe must be done in increasing step_index.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the appliance required to perform this step (which appliance must be used for the step).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: How long the step takes on its required appliance (time units); the appliance will be occupied for this duration when the step runs.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of patients (cases) that must be scheduled through the clinical pathway; each patient is a separate job whose stages must be performed in order.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct rooms/resources (e.g., pre-op, OR, PACU, recovery rooms) that can host a single patient activity at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each patient/case to be scheduled. Each identifier corresponds to one job with a fixed sequence of stages.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each room/resource. Each identifier denotes a room where certain clinical stages (tasks) must take place and that cannot be double-booked.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the patient (which job the task belongs to). Used to group tasks into the ordered sequence of stages for that patient.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the stage within the patient's ordered pathway (1 = first stage, 2 = second, etc.). Tasks for a patient must be scheduled in increasing stage_index order without reordering.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific room/resource required for this stage of the patient's pathway. The stage must be scheduled in this room and the room cannot host overlapping stages.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed processing time required for this stage (e.g., minutes). The room must be reserved for this continuous duration when the stage is scheduled.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of construction units (distinct jobs) to be completed; each unit consists of a fixed sequence of operations that must be scheduled without reordering.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of heavy equipment pieces available (machines); each piece of equipment can perform at most one operation at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each construction unit/job to be finished (e.g., ['Unit1','Unit2']); these group the sequence of operations that must be executed in order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the heavy equipment pieces (machines) available for assignment (e.g., ['CraneA','ExcavatorB']).

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the construction unit that this operation belongs to; must match one value from 'construction_unit_ids'.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this operation within the unit's required sequence (the order in which steps must be executed), typically a 1-based integer.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific heavy equipment piece required to perform this operation; must match one value from 'equipment_ids'.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed time required to complete the operation on the specified equipment, expressed in the scenario's time units (e.g., hours); durations are not preemptible.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of features (jobs) to build. This is the count of independent feature pipelines that must be scheduled.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of build servers (machines) available. Each server can execute at most one pipeline step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: An ordered list or set of feature identifiers. Each identifier corresponds to one feature pipeline that consists of a sequence of steps to schedule.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: An ordered list or set of server identifiers. Each identifier names a specific server that some pipeline steps require.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the feature this step belongs to (links the step to a specific feature pipeline).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of the step within the feature's ordered pipeline (the sequence order that must be preserved when scheduling).

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific server required to run this step. The step must be executed on this server and the server can run only one step at a time.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time needed to complete this step on its assigned server. Used to compute start/finish times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of garments to be produced (i.e., number of jobs). Each garment is a separate job that must pass through its ordered list of operations.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of distinct workstations/stations in the shop (i.e., number of machines). Each station can process at most one operation at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Array/list of identifiers for the garments (jobs). These identifiers are used to reference each garment's sequence of operations and to enforce per-garment ordering.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Array/list of identifiers for the stations/machines available in the shop. Operation entries reference these identifiers to indicate where they must be processed.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the garment (job) that this operation belongs to; must match one of the entries in 'garment_ids'.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position index of this operation within the garment's fixed sequence (e.g., 1 for first operation). Operations for a garment must be scheduled in increasing index order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required station for this operation; must match one of the entries in 'station_ids'. At any moment a station can handle only one operation.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required on the specified station for this operation. This is the non‑preemptive continuous time the operation occupies the station and is used to compute the schedule and overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of customer baskets (loads) that must go through the laundry workflow. Each load is a job with its own sequence of cycles.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of physical machines (washers and dryers) available in the facility that can run cycles; each machine can handle only one cycle at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: A list of identifiers for each customer load/basket (each identifier corresponds to one job whose cycles must be scheduled in order).

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: A list of identifiers for each washer or dryer (the appliances on which cycles run). These identifiers are referenced by individual cycle requirements.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the customer load (which basket this cycle belongs to). Matches one entry from the global load_ids list.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this cycle within the load's fixed recipe (0-based or 1-based index) indicating the required order of cycles for that load.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific appliance (washer or dryer) required for this cycle. The cycle must be scheduled on that appliance and no two cycles can overlap on the same appliance.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: How long this cycle runs on its appliance, expressed in consistent time units (e.g., minutes). This is the processing time that blocks the appliance for that interval.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of cars that must go through the full sequence of detailing services in the garage; this is the count of jobs to schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct service bays/stations available in the garage; each bay can handle at most one car at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each car to service (one identifier per job). Each identifier links a car to its ordered list of services.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each service bay/station in the garage. Tasks that require the same bay cannot overlap in time.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the car (job) that this service belongs to; matches one entry from the car_ids list.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this service within the car's required sequence (0-based or 1-based index as used in the instance). Services for a car must be performed in increasing service_index order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific bay/station where this service must be performed; refers to one entry from bay_ids and enforces that the bay handles only one car at a time.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed processing time required for this service on the assigned bay, expressed in the schedule's time units (e.g., minutes); durations are immutable and determine start/end times.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct metal parts (each part is a job) that must go through the shop today — the count of job sequences to schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of separate machines or workstations available in the shop; each machine can process at most one operation at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the parts to be manufactured. Each identifier refers to one job and is used to link that job to its ordered sequence of operations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for machines/workstations in the shop. These IDs are referenced by each operation to indicate which machine must perform that step.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the part (job) that this specific operation belongs to — must match an entry from the parts_list.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this operation in the fixed sequence of steps for the part (operation order within the job). Use a consistent numbering convention (e.g., 1-based) to indicate precedence.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the machine that must perform this operation — must match one of the machine_ids; the operation can only run on this machine.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time required for the machine to complete this operation on the part, expressed in consistent time units. The operation occupies the required_machine_id for this entire duration (non-preemptive).

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of bouquets to be assembled. This tells the scheduler how many separate job sequences (each a bouquet) must be completed.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: The number of distinct workstations (arranging tables or wrapping benches) available on the assembly line, each able to handle at most one bouquet step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: The identifiers for each bouquet (job). Tasks sharing the same bouquet_id belong to the same ordered sequence of steps that must be performed in order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: The identifiers for the workstations (machines) where steps are performed. Each id corresponds to a specific table or bench in the assembly area.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the bouquet this task belongs to; used to enforce the intra-bouquet order constraint (tasks with the same bouquet_id must be performed in their given sequence).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the step within its bouquet's sequence (e.g., first arranging step, then trimming, then wrapping). The scheduler must respect these indices so a step cannot start before the previous step in the same bouquet finishes.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the workstation required for this step (specific arranging table or wrapping bench). At any time, a given required_station_id can host at most one step.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time that the step occupies its required workstation (in time units, e.g., minutes). The scheduler uses this to compute start/end times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of program segments in the rundown that must be processed through all required steps before the show can be handed off.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct studios/suites/rooms available to perform processing steps; each room can handle at most one step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Ordered or named identifiers for each segment in the broadcast lineup that needs scheduling.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each studio/suite/room that can be assigned to perform segment steps.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific program segment this processing step belongs to (matches one of the segment_ids).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this step in the segment's required sequence of tasks (defines ordering; earlier step_index must finish before later ones for the same segment).

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The specific studio/suite/room required to perform this step for the segment (must match one of the room_ids).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The time the step occupies the assigned room (in the schedule's time units, e.g., minutes); the room is unavailable to other steps during this interval.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of batches to send through the packaging line. Tells the solver how many jobs (batches) must be scheduled in total.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of physical machines or stations on the line (e.g., filler, capper, labeler, packer). Each station can process at most one step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each batch to be processed. Each identifier is referenced by the batch's sequence of steps/tasks.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the available machines/stations on the packaging line. Task entries refer to these ids to indicate where a step must run.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the batch that this task (step) belongs to; must match one of the batch_ids. Groups tasks into the ordered sequence for that batch.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of the step within the batch's fixed sequence (e.g., 1=fill, 2=cap, 3=label, 4=pack). Determines the required order: a step cannot start before earlier step_index for the same batch finishes.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific station required for this step; must match one of the station_ids. The station must be free for the step's duration to run.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed processing time required for this step on its station, in consistent time units (e.g., minutes). Used to compute start/finish times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of classes (distinct groups of students) that need a sequence of planned sessions to be scheduled. This tells the scheduler how many job sequences to arrange.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of rooms available to host sessions. Each room can host at most one session at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: A list of identifiers for each class. Each identifier refers to one class whose ordered list of sessions must be scheduled in sequence.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: A list of identifiers for the rooms. Each identifier corresponds to a specific room where sessions may take place.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the class to which this session belongs. Used to enforce the order of sessions for that class.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this session within the class's required sequence of sessions (i.e., which session comes first, second, etc.). Sessions for a class must be scheduled in this order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the room required for this session. The session must be placed in this room, and a room cannot host overlapping sessions.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed duration (in the schedule's time units, e.g., minutes or blocks) that the session occupies the assigned room. Durations are immutable and determine when each session ends.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of patients to schedule; each patient is a job consisting of an ordered sequence of scans that must be performed in order.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of available imaging scanners (distinct machines). Each scanner can run at most one scan at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of patient identifiers used to reference each patient's ordered scan sequence (one entry per patient/job).

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of scanner identifiers for the available imaging devices; scan tasks refer to these to indicate which scanner they must use.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the patient this scan belongs to; must match one entry from the patient_ids list and groups tasks into a patient's ordered sequence.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this scan within the patient's required sequence (order number). This scan must start no earlier than the previous scan for the same patient has finished.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the scanner required for this scan; must match one entry from scanner_ids. The scan must run on this scanner and cannot overlap in time with other scans assigned to the same scanner.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Exact processing time the scan occupies the assigned scanner (in the instance's time units, e.g., minutes). Scans are non-preemptive and must run for this full duration once started.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of projects to schedule in the studio. Used by the scheduler to know how many project workflows (each with three steps) must be placed on workstations.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct workstations available (editing bays, color grading suites, sound studios). Each workstation can handle only one step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each project (one entry per project). These identifiers tie the sequence of steps for that project to its scheduled start and finish times.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each workstation. Each task specifies one of these identifiers to indicate which physical workstation must be used for that step.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the project to which this step belongs (matches an entry from project_ids). Ensures this task is scheduled in the correct project sequence.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the step within the project's fixed sequence (1 = editing, 2 = color grading, 3 = sound mixing). Enforces the order in which the project's steps must be executed.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the workstation required for this step (must match one of workstation_ids). The scheduler must ensure no two steps overlap on the same workstation.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The time required to complete this step on the assigned workstation (in the same time units used across the instance). The scheduler uses this to allocate start and end times and compute the makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of client sessions (each session is a job consisting of an ordered list of shots and retouches) that must be scheduled.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct physical resources available in the studio (both photo sets and retouching/editing stations) that cannot be double booked.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the client sessions to schedule; each identifier refers to one ordered sequence of tasks (shots/edits).

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the studio resources (each identifier denotes a specific set or editing station) used by tasks.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the client session to which this task belongs (links the task to its ordered session sequence).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this task within its session's ordered list (e.g., first shot, second retouch); tasks must be executed in increasing step_index for the same session.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific studio resource required for this task (which photo set or editing station must be reserved for the task's duration).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Length of time the task occupies its assigned resource, expressed in the scheduling time units used by the studio (e.g., minutes).

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of drones in the morning fleet that need their fixed sequence of checks and charging sessions scheduled (i.e., the number of jobs).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct charging pads or maintenance benches available (i.e., machines); no two tasks may use the same pad at the same time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of drone identifiers (one per job). Each identifier links that drone to its ordered list of required steps.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of pad or bench identifiers (machines). Task entries reference these identifiers to specify where a step must be performed.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the drone (job) this step belongs to; used to enforce the per-drone ordering of steps.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the step within the drone's required sequence (0-based or 1-based as specified); steps with smaller indices must complete before later ones start for the same drone.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the pad or bench where this drone step must be executed; ensures the task is scheduled on the correct machine and enforces exclusive use.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed processing time the step occupies the specified pad (in consistent units, e.g., minutes). Each step is continuous and non-preemptive for this duration.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of outbound containers to schedule. Each container is treated as a job whose sequence of loading and inspection operations must be executed in order.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct service locations (docks and inspection lanes) available at the port. Each station can handle at most one operation at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Ordered list of identifiers for the containers to be processed. Each identifier corresponds to one job and links that container to its sequence of operations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for all docks and inspection lanes (the machines). Each identifier is used by tasks to specify which station the operation must run on.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the container (matches an entry in container_ids) that this operation belongs to. Used to group operations into the container's required sequence.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this operation within the container's prescribed sequence (first, second, etc.). Operations for a container must start only after all earlier-indexed operations for that container are finished.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the dock or inspection lane required for this operation (must match one of the station_ids). This is the single station that will be occupied while the operation runs.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time that the operation occupies its required station. All durations use the same time units and determine how long the station is blocked for that operation.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of exam batches that must be processed through the grading workflow; each batch corresponds to one job consisting of an ordered sequence of review steps.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct review workstations/tables available in the grading room; each workstation can handle at most one review step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the exam batches to be graded. Each identifier references a specific batch and its ordered list of review steps.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the review workstations/tables where individual steps must be performed.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the exam batch that this review step belongs to (must match one entry in batch_ids).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this review step within the batch's fixed sequence; steps for a batch must be executed in ascending step_index order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific workstation where this review step must be performed; the step must be scheduled on this workstation and cannot be processed elsewhere.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The amount of time the workstation will be occupied to perform this review step for the batch, expressed in the scheduling time units used for the plan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct product sets to be packaged. Each product set is a job that must flow through the fixed sequence of packaging operations (boxing, labeling, sealing).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of packing machines/stations available across all steps (for example, individual boxing stations, labeling stations, sealing stations). Each machine can handle at most one operation at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the product sets to schedule. Each identifier corresponds to a job that must follow its fixed sequence of packaging operations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of machine identifiers available in the packing area. These identifiers are referenced by tasks to indicate which machine must perform that operation.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the product set (job) this operation belongs to — must match one of the entries in 'product_set_ids'.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this operation within the product set's required packaging sequence. In this scenario the sequence corresponds to ordered steps (e.g., 1 = boxing, 2 = labeling, 3 = sealing); later operations cannot start before earlier ones finish for the same set.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific machine/station required to perform this operation (must match an entry in 'machine_ids'). This determines which machine is blocked while the operation runs.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed time the operation occupies its assigned machine (in the schedule's time units). Durations are non-preemptive and are used to compute start/end times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct menu items (dishes) that must be prepared and plated for the banquet; each menu item is a separate job with its own ordered sequence of stages.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of physical prep or plating stations available (e.g., oven, stove, plating table); each station can process at most one stage at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each menu item (job) to be prepared. These IDs link the sequence of stages specific to each dish.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each prep/plating station (machine). Stage entries reference these IDs to indicate where a stage must be performed.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the menu item (which dish) that this stage belongs to; ties the stage into that dish's ordered recipe steps.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this stage within its menu item's fixed recipe sequence (e.g., 1 for first step, 2 for second). Stages for the same menu must be executed in increasing index order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the prep or plating station required for this stage. The stage must be scheduled on that specific station and cannot overlap with other stages on the same station.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The processing time required to complete this stage on its assigned station (e.g., minutes). This is a non-preemptive processing time that contributes to the dish's completion time.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of vehicles (cars) that need service today — the number of separate jobs the planner must schedule across the shop.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of distinct service locations (including lifts and diagnostic bays) available in the shop; each location can handle at most one repair step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each vehicle to be serviced (one per job). These labels are used to group the ordered sequence of repair steps belonging to the same car.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each lift or diagnostic bay in the shop. Each repair step references one of these IDs to indicate where it must be performed.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the vehicle that this repair step belongs to. Steps with the same vehicle_id must be performed in the given order.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this repair step within the vehicle's fixed sequence (e.g., 1 for first step, 2 for second). This enforces per-vehicle ordering constraints.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The specific lift or diagnostic bay where this repair step must be performed; the scheduler must not assign another step to that bay at overlapping times.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The time required to complete this repair step at its assigned bay (measured in consistent time units). The scheduler uses this to reserve the bay for that length of time.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of outfits to be processed in the workshop. Each outfit represents a job made up of an ordered sequence of operations (e.g., stitching → pressing → finishing).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of physical machines and presses available in the sewing room that can perform operations. This is the pool of resources that tasks must be assigned to without overlap.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each outfit/job to be scheduled. These IDs group the ordered tasks that belong to the same outfit and determine task precedence.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for every machine and press in the workshop (e.g., sewing_machine_1, press_2). Tasks specify one of these IDs as the required resource.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the outfit this task belongs to. Used to enforce the outfit's internal ordering so earlier operations finish before later ones start.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the operation within the outfit's fixed sequence (e.g., 0 = first operation such as stitching, 1 = next such as pressing). The index enforces precedence order for that outfit.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific machine or press required for this operation (must match one of the global machine_ids). The task must run on this machine and machines cannot run overlapping tasks.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time the required machine needs to perform this operation on the outfit (in the chosen time unit). This duration is reserved on the required_machine_id and contributes to the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of events that must be scheduled. Each event is a job composed of a fixed sequence of activities (e.g., setup, rehearsal, teardown).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct resources available (rooms and pieces of equipment). Each resource can host at most one activity at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the events to schedule. Each identifier corresponds to a job whose activities must be performed in the given order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the available rooms and equipment. Activities declare which resource id they require and must be scheduled on that exact resource.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the event (from event_ids) to which this activity belongs.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this activity within its event's required sequence (defines ordering: earlier indices must finish before later ones start).

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific room or piece of equipment required for this activity (must match one of resource_ids).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Exact continuous time length the activity needs the specified resource; scheduling must allocate an uninterrupted interval of this length.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of film rolls to process through the darkroom; this tells the manager how many separate job sequences (each roll's exposure→development→drying steps) must be scheduled.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of darkroom stations available (e.g., exposure bench, development tank(s), drying rack(s)); determines how many tasks can run in parallel across the room.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each film roll (each is a job). Each identifier is used to group that roll's ordered processing steps and to report its completion time.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each darkroom station. Each identifier is referenced by tasks to indicate which specific station a step must use.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the film roll this task belongs to (matches an entry in roll_ids); used to enforce the roll's task order and to collect its completion time.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this processing step within the roll's fixed sequence (e.g., 1 for exposure, 2 for development, 3 for drying); order must be preserved when scheduling.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific darkroom station required for this step (must match one of the station_ids); no two tasks can occupy the same station at overlapping times.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Required run time for this step on its assigned station (the length of time that station is occupied for this task); used to compute start/finish times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of projects waiting in the makerspace; each project is treated as a job composed of ordered steps (cutting, sanding, painting) that must all be scheduled.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct workshop machines or stations available (for example cutting table(s), sanding station(s), paint booth(s)). Each machine can perform at most one step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the projects to schedule. Each identifier refers to a job whose steps must be executed in the specified order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the available machines/stations in the makerspace. These IDs are referenced by each step to indicate which machine must perform it.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the project (job) that this task/step belongs to; used to enforce the sequence of steps for that project.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position index of this step within the project's ordered sequence (e.g., 0 = first step, 1 = second step). Steps must be scheduled in increasing index order for the same project.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific machine/station required to perform this step. The step must run on this machine and cannot overlap in time with other steps assigned to the same machine.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed processing time that this step occupies its assigned machine (in the instance's time units). Once started, the step occupies the machine continuously for this duration.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of garden plots that must be completed. Each plot is a separate job consisting of the fixed sequence of steps (digging, planting, mulching).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct crews or machines (teams and tools) available to perform tasks. Each is a resource that can handle at most one task at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the garden plots to schedule. Each identifier corresponds to a job that must go through the full sequence of steps in order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each crew or machine (team/tool). Tasks reference these identifiers to indicate which crew or machine must perform them.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the garden plot this task belongs to (matches one of the plot_ids). Used to enforce the ordering of steps for that specific plot.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this task within the plot's fixed sequence (e.g., 1 = digging, 2 = planting, 3 = mulching). Tasks for a plot must be scheduled in increasing step_index order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the crew or machine required to perform this specific step for the plot (must match one of the crew_machine_ids). That resource will be occupied for the task's duration and cannot run overlapping work.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time the specified crew or machine needs to complete this task on the plot. The scheduler uses these durations to avoid overlaps and to minimize the overall completion time (makespan).

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of exam sets (batches) that need to be processed through the print room workflow.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct pieces of equipment in the print room (e.g., printers, staplers, packing tables) available for processing tasks.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each exam set (batch). Each identifier identifies a job whose tasks must be performed in order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each equipment unit in the room. Tasks reference these to indicate which machine they must run on.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the exam set (batch) that this task belongs to. Used to enforce the sequence of operations for that set.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index (position) of this operation within the exam set's fixed sequence (e.g., 0=printing, 1=stapling, 2=packing). Determines precedence constraints inside the same set.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific piece of equipment required for this operation (for example a particular printer or stapler). The operation must be scheduled on this equipment and equipment cannot run two operations at once.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time the operation occupies its equipment (in the instance's time units, e.g., minutes). The equipment is blocked for this duration when the operation runs.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of furniture pieces to produce; each piece is a job that must go through a fixed sequence of workshop operations (cutting, assembly, finishing).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct workstations in the shop (e.g., saws, assembly benches, spray booths). Each station can process at most one operation at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the furniture pieces (jobs) to be scheduled (e.g., ['P1','P2']). Each identifier denotes one complete item that requires a sequence of operations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of workstation identifiers available in the workshop (e.g., ['SawA','Bench2','Booth1']). Operation machine requirements reference these station IDs.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the furniture piece that the operation belongs to; must match one entry from 'pieces'. Used to group operations and enforce the piece's operation order.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the operation within the piece's fixed sequence (1 for first operation, 2 for second, etc.). Operations for the same piece must be executed in increasing operation_index order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific workstation required for this operation (one of the 'stations'), e.g., a particular saw, bench, or spray booth where this step must run.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time required to perform the operation at its station, expressed in consistent time units (e.g., minutes). Used to compute start and end times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of portrait sessions (clients) that need to be scheduled across makeup, shooting, and retouching.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of physical assets available (makeup chairs, photo studios, retouching stations) that tasks can use.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each portrait session to schedule (e.g., client or session numbers). Each identifier represents one job consisting of a sequence of steps.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each asset (e.g., makeup_chair_1, studio_2, retouch_station_1). Tasks specifying an asset_id must run on that asset and assets cannot be double-booked.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the portrait session this step belongs to; must match one entry from 'session_ids'.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the step within the session's required sequence (e.g., makeup then shooting then retouch). Steps for a session must be performed in increasing step_index order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific asset required for this step (must match one entry from 'asset_ids'), indicating which chair or room will be used.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time the step occupies the specified asset, expressed in the schedule's time units (e.g., minutes). The asset is unavailable to other steps for this duration.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of electronic units (devices) that must be processed through the depot; this is the count of jobs the coordinator must schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of repair benches available at the depot; each bench corresponds to a specific workstation where certain steps (diagnostics, parts replacement, testing) take place.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each electronic unit/device to be repaired; each identifier denotes a job whose steps must be scheduled in order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each bench/workstation in the depot; tasks specify which bench they require and the schedule must ensure no two tasks use the same bench at the same time.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the electronic unit (from device_ids) that this task belongs to; ties the task to the job whose steps must run in sequence.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the step within the device's fixed sequence (e.g., 1 = diagnostics, 2 = parts replacement, 3 = testing); order must be preserved when scheduling start times.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific bench required for this step (from bench_ids); this bench must be reserved for the task's full duration and cannot host overlapping tasks.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required on the specified bench to complete this step for the device (expressed in consistent time units); the scheduler must allocate this continuous time interval on the bench.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of builds in the batch that must be scheduled; each build corresponds to one job consisting of an ordered list of steps.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of available build servers; each server can execute at most one step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Ordered list of identifiers for the builds in the batch (e.g., names or indices) referenced by each step entry.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the build servers available to run steps; these identifiers are used by each step to specify its required server.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the build (job) that this step belongs to, linking the step to that build's ordered sequence of steps.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this step within its build's sequence (index indicating the execution order for that build).

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific build server required to run this step; the server must be free for the step's entire duration.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required to complete this step on its assigned server (in the time units used by the instance); the server is occupied for this full duration when the step runs.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of pottery pieces (jobs) that must each go through the studio workflow of throwing, trimming and glazing. This is the count of distinct pieces to schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of dedicated work stations (machines) in the studio. Each station corresponds to a specific operation area (e.g., throwing wheel(s), trimming bench(es), glazing station(s)) and can process at most one piece at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each pottery piece to be produced (e.g., piece_1, piece_2). Each identifier denotes one job whose tasks must be performed in the given artist sequence.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the studio stations (e.g., throwing_1, trimming_1, glazing_1). Each identifier names a machine/station capable of performing a specific operation type.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the pottery piece this task belongs to (matches an entry in piece_ids). Used to enforce that tasks for the same piece follow the artist's required order.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the step within the piece's fixed workflow (1 = first step: throwing, 2 = second: trimming, 3 = third: glazing). This enforces the sequence order for that piece.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the station that must perform this step (must be one of station_ids). Indicates which physical workspace the step requires (e.g., a throwing wheel, a trimming bench, or a glazing area).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The time required to perform this step on the required station (in the scenario's time units). This is the uninterrupted processing duration during which the station is occupied for that piece.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of furniture pieces (jobs) to make — e.g., number of tables and chairs that must go through measuring, cutting and assembly.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct workshop tools/stations available (machines) such as measuring stations, cutting saws, and assembly benches.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each furniture piece (each job) that needs the three-step process; each identifier refers to one table or chair unit to be completed.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the workshop tools/stations (machines). Each identifier names a specific tool that can perform certain steps (measuring, cutting, or assembly).

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the furniture piece (job) this task belongs to — ties the task to the particular table or chair being processed.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the task within the piece's fixed sequence (e.g., 1 = measuring, 2 = cutting, 3 = assembly); tasks must be performed in this order for each piece.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific workshop tool/station (machine) required for this step (which measuring station, which saw, or which assembly bench will be used).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required for this task (how long the step takes on the assigned tool), expressed in the chosen time units (e.g., minutes).

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of product batches that must go through the factory (each batch must complete blend → fill → seal). This is the number of jobs to schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Count of distinct physical machines available in the factory (e.g., individual blenders, fillers, sealers). Machines are exclusive resources that cannot run overlapping tasks.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each product batch to be scheduled. Each identifier refers to one job that follows the fixed sequence of operations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each physical machine (e.g., 'Blender-1', 'Filler-2', 'Sealer-1'). These identify which machine a task requires and are used to enforce no-overlap constraints.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the batch this task belongs to (must match one entry in batch_ids). Used to enforce task order per batch.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the operation within the batch's processing sequence (1 = blend, 2 = fill, 3 = seal). Tasks for a batch must be scheduled in increasing operation_index order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific physical machine required for this operation (must match one entry in machine_ids). The named machine must be reserved for the task's duration and cannot run overlapping tasks.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed processing time for the operation on the required machine (in the scenario's time units). This is the time the machine is occupied when that task runs.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of architectural models that must be completed. Each model is a job that will undergo cutting, painting and final assembly in that order.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of dedicated workbenches available in the workshop. Each workbench is a machine that can perform one stage at a time (e.g., a cutting bench, a painting bench, an assembly bench).

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: The identifiers for each model/job to be processed (one identifier per model). These link tasks to the particular model they belong to.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the workbenches (machines) in the shop. These names/IDs specify which bench a task must use.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the model this task belongs to. Tasks sharing the same model_id must be performed in the specified order (cutting → painting → assembly).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the stage within the model's processing sequence (e.g., 0 = first stage cutting, 1 = painting, 2 = final assembly). Order must be preserved when scheduling.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Which workbench (machine) the stage must run on — for example the specific cutting bench, painting bench, or assembly bench required by this task.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: How long the stage occupies its assigned workbench (a fixed time unit per task). This is the time the bench is blocked and cannot run other tasks.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of samples that must be processed through the lab workflow that morning; each sample is a separate job consisting of ordered steps.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct instruments (machines) available in the facility; each instrument can run at most one step at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each sample/job (e.g., sample A, B, C) that define the sequence of steps that sample must undergo in order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each instrument (e.g., centrifuge1, spectrometer2) that label which resource a step requires.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the sample to which this step belongs; ties the step to its required predecessor/successor order within that sample's workflow.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this step in the sample's fixed sequence (1 = first step, 2 = second, ...); steps for a sample must start respecting this order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the instrument required to perform this step; this step can only run on that specified instrument and cannot overlap with other tasks using the same instrument.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The fixed time length that the step occupies its required instrument once started; used to compute start/end times and overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of toys (jobs) that must be assembled and shipped; the scheduler must assign all steps for each toy.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct work stations (machines) available in the factory (e.g., stamping stations, painting booths, packaging counters).

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each toy to be produced (e.g., Toy1, Toy2). Each identifier links that toy's sequence of tasks: stamping -> painting -> packaging.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each station (e.g., StampingA, Paint1, Pack2). These are the specific resources tasks must be assigned to and cannot overlap in time.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the toy (job) to which this task belongs; used to enforce that this task follows and precedes other tasks for the same toy in the prescribed order.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this task in the toy's fixed sequence. Use 1=stamping, 2=painting, 3=packaging so the solver enforces stamping before painting before packaging for each toy.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific station required for this task (must match one of the station_ids). The station handles only one task at a time.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time required (in the chosen time unit, e.g., minutes) for the task to complete on the specified station; used to compute start/end times and the overall makespan.
